attempt_2.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach while guards hold the choke, keeping watch over the pressing crowd. Nearby, a notice board displays updates on new taxes, curfew orders, and a warning about a missing patrol. A tavern runner calls out eagerly, hawking hot stew and paid gossip to passersby. Across the square, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors, a stark contrast to the clamorous, muddy streets. Among the crowd, a figure in threadbare clothes stands eerily still, eyes shifting toward the packs and faces more than the gate queue. The cold rain drizzles steadily over the eastern gate under the frayed banners as the approach remains jammed with travelers and tired guards alike.
